name: Neko no Yume
detailed_description:
Fulfilling your greatest dream is just the beginning… but what if your dreams held a deeper meaning?

In this dating visual novel filled with romance, comedy, and a touch of mystery, you'll follow the story of Konekomaru Takagi, a young man who finally gets accepted into the most prestigious university in the world. However, what seemed like a new chapter of learning and friendship soon turns into an unexpected journey as he meets a group of girls who will change his fate.

Throughout this story, Konekomaru will experience humorous moments, emotional encounters, and situations wrapped in an aura of mystery. As he grows closer to each girl, his dreams become increasingly strange… Do they hide a secret meaning? Are they warnings or forgotten memories?

💖 Romance, comedy, and a mystery to uncover:
✨ Lighthearted and funny moments that will make you laugh.
💔 Heartfelt scenes that will challenge Konekomaru’s emotions.
🕵️‍♂️ A touch of mystery: What secrets lie behind the dreams that haunt him every night?
🎭 A cast of memorable characters, each with their own story and secrets to reveal.

Your choices will not only shape your relationships but also bring you closer to the truth behind Konekomaru’s dreams. Will you find true love and solve the mystery before it’s too late?

📝 Features:
🎨 Beautifully detailed artwork with expressive characters and vibrant backgrounds.
🎶 An immersive soundtrack that enhances every emotion.
📖 Multiple routes and endings, some romantic… others more intriguing.
💬 Dynamic dialogues and unique situations, where every choice brings you closer to the truth.

Love, comedy, and an unexpected mystery await you in this unforgettable story. Uncover the truth behind your dreams and forge your own destiny!
